description: Observe lifecycle and pending attention from 1..1000 existing durable job/run handles in one read. targets contains {runId, seen?}; waitMs defaults to 25000 (0..50000). Echo each summary token as that target's seen to suppress unchanged terminal/question attention; tokens are not event cursors or answers. Returns ascending attention indexes and compact summaries in input order, including duplicates and explicit unknowns, within 128 KiB of logical JSON. waitMs=0 reads once; timeout never retries. Discovery adds up to 5s and HTTP adds up to waitMs+5s (total waitMs+10s). Host abort closes only observation; discovery's read-only handshake may settle in the background. Requires an existing supporting daemon; never starts one or a worker. Terminal lifecycle is not output readiness: use claudexor_run_result for output and claudexor_run_interactions for question bodies.

inputSchema.description: Read-only attention observation; compact request JSON is at most 1048576 UTF-8 bytes.

name: claudexor_runs_wait

outputSchema.description: Lifecycle and pending attention only, at most 131072 UTF-8 JSON bytes; output readiness is a separate addressed read.

status.description: Control-plane run state = the run LIFECYCLE (D8): queued/running while live, then exactly one of succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted. Outcome quality (checks/review/delivery) is orthogonal — see outcomeFacts.
